study_title: Redox Influence on Microbial Communities in Anaerobic Coastal Sediments
study_description: We inoculated anaerobic sediments from 3 different depths using two different reducing agents (sodium dithionite and titanium (III) citrate) at varied redoxes (-150, -300, -340, -380, and -570mV) over 150 days to assess longterm affects on microbial community composition.
experiment_title: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing of coastal marine sediment
